verdict.rationale: Granola Chat lets you ask questions across your meetings and draw on notes or transcripts, including spotting patterns across calls. The MCP integration lets external AI tools search notes and transcripts and find topics discussed in past meetings. The magnifying-glass feature shows where in the transcript or raw notes an AI-generated note came from, which is a partial form of jumping to the moment something was said. Missing for 10: a native full-text search UI across all meetings, jumping straight from a search result to the exact transcript moment, timestamped or audio playback navigation, and independent hands-on corroboration.
